translation.Premier League matches and the Champions: Premier League matches and the Championship table from football-data.org. Paste your API key; it stays in iCUE on this PC. Your club (for example Brentford, Spurs or BRE) is pinned to the top row; your Championship club is highlighted in the table. Tap MATCHES or CHAMPIONSHIP at the top to switch; tap the one showing to open that table on Google.
